diagnostic_scope: gold-blind structural diagnostics only (spec section 27); no route accuracy, expected safety accuracy, forbidden-claim score, or Measurement V3 accuracy computed
discovery_invocation_basis: no case carries location_context.municipality, so run_discovery_step() returns NOT_APPLICABLE before run_discovery(); the 16 SUCCESS / 104 RECOVERABLE local_discovery stage states are bookkeeping in _stage_state() (suppressed-routing cases leave no failure record), not discovery executions
rendered_vs_structured_reading: the only route-like rendered lines are the four frozen acute-safety instruction lines (ring 113, ring 116 123, politiet 02800, ring 116 117 legevakt), which are emergency instructions, not discovery routes; every structured routes[] entry renders with its service_type label verified as a substring of the ASCII answer
provenance_linkage_rule: national route i of n in a case maps to provenance record P-K%03d (P-K001 and upward); all present
determinism_method: independent full rerun into runs/determinism-check-v2/; prediction files compared byte-wise by SHA-256 (120 of 120 identical); latency fields live only in run-log and are excluded by design
